title: Product of Array Except Self
statement:
Given an integer array `nums`, return an array `answer` where `answer[i]` is the product of every element of `nums` except `nums[i]`.

Solve it in **O(n)** time **without using division**.
constraints: Every product fits in a 32-bit integer
hints: answer[i] is (product of everything to the left of i) × (product of everything to the right of i).
Fill answer with prefix products in one pass left to right, then multiply in suffix products with a running variable in a second pass right to left.
editorial: Two passes: `answer[i]` first holds the product of everything left of `i`; then a running `right` product sweeps from the end, multiplying it in. No division, so zeros need no special case. **O(n)** time, **O(1)** extra space besides the output.
